title: Payload
notes: The game first asks for a profile: choose New Profile, pick letters on the on-screen keyboard with the pad and key 5 (or OK), then move down to DONE.
In menus and briefings key 5 selects or continues and key 7 goes back; hold 5 to skip the Story intro.
The right soft key pauses a race.
Double-tap left or right to shunt and double-tap down for a 180 degree turn.
Multiplayer and N-Gage Arena are not available in the browser.

controls.source: The game's own Default Key Controls screen, shown while a mission loads, and the Select 5 / Back 7 labels in its menus. Accelerating (up and 5), steering, the map (#), race info (9) and the right soft key's pause menu were also observed in the first race. Publisher and year are from the game's copyright screen.
notes: Racing layout: W or the up arrow accelerates, S or down brakes, A and D or the arrows steer. Space uses the weapon, F raises the shield, E and R change weapon, B looks behind, C changes the camera, M shows the map and Tab the race info. Enter or 5 selects in menus, Backspace or 7 goes back, Esc pauses.

On a gamepad the left stick or pad steers (up and down also accelerate and brake), RT accelerates and LT brakes; in menus RT or A selects and LT goes back. X uses the weapon, B the shield, Y looks behind, LB and RB change weapon, Start pauses, Back shows race info, and the stick clicks change the camera and show the map.

statusNote: Logos, profile creation, the main menu, the Story intro and the mission briefing work, and the first Story mission (a pit qualifier on Tenant Salt Flats) plays in 3D: accelerating, steering, the map, race info and the pause menu were tried.
